2. C5: the scope of each read can only be checked on named lines (scope of a call, 10 per line). With 101 reads that is far more than the allowance of 50, so the plan cannot cover C5 in full. During the work I can check only a few chosen lines.

5. Budget: an undo rehearsal at A3 (33) would not fit within the 200 limit.
